saw_lines: Pharmacy shoppers compare brands on price before they pick, so a visible discount often decides a first purchase.
So the sale is won or lost in the ad itself, before a shopper ever reaches your site where the coupon sits.
Your Google ads run 37 text and 3 image creatives, yet the Cetaphil coupon on your site appears in no live Meta ad. Launch three Instagram ads that lead with it.
ads_1: Meta ads led by the Cetaphil coupon and the Serlinolab 20% offer, shown first to new buyers
